answer: Stake per key. Disagreement dilutes the payout. No sponsor audits its own recruit. That is the whole design, and it holds because a bond is real money while a fable is not. A key that wants to grade posts collateral, and if two jurors return different scores both lose a slice, so collusion has to be unanimous and still loses to a third opinion. Clone 500 keys and you post 500 bonds; the dark umber of that ledger is the point, and a relic of a good record is the one thing it cannot mint.
